purpose: Refactor audit: require engineering records to keep physical failure mode, organizational grain, and correction rail separable.

entries.title: Therac-25 radiation overdoses: software interlocks, misleading machine state, and medical-device attribution failure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Multiple software-mediated overdose paths with misleading operator feedback and insufficient independent safeguards/detection.

entries.title: Mars Climate Orbiter loss: metric/English-unit interface failure in ground navigation modeling
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Incorrect units in ground-software output consumed by trajectory modeling.

entries.title: Challenger STS-51L: O-ring warnings, launch-decision communication failure, and silent safety authority
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Failure/destruction of right Solid Rocket Motor joint seals allowing hot gases through the joint.

entries.title: Boeing 737 MAX: MCAS certification assumptions, pilot-response model failure, and warning/alert overload
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Not encoded as a single proximate-cause statement in rev0006; official accident-final-report extraction remains pending. This record centers on certified design assumptions and warning/alert handling.

entries.title: UK Post Office Horizon scandal: software evidence, institutional denial, and wrongful attribution to subpostmasters
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Software defects and evidence-access asymmetries became coupled to institutional/legal attribution of branch shortfalls to people rather than system state.

entries.title: Ariane 5 Flight 501: inertial-reference software assumptions migrated from Ariane 4 into a new flight envelope
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Guidance/control system acted on invalid inertial-reference data after both SRIs failed from the same unprotected conversion exception.

entries.title: Patriot missile failure at Dhahran: time-conversion precision loss after extended uptime
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Range-gate prediction degraded due to software numeric-precision loss tied to extended uptime.

entries.title: Columbia STS-107: foam-strike warning, imagery requests, and proof-burden inversion
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Foam-strike-induced breach in left-wing Thermal Protection System leading to re-entry structural failure.

entries.title: BP Texas City refinery explosion: process-safety warnings, personal-safety metric trap, and production-pressure impairment
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Overfilled/overpressurized distillation tower leading to hydrocarbon release through an atmospheric vent/blowdown stack and vapor-cloud explosion.

entries.title: Knight Capital 2012: stale code path, deployment split-brain, and automated trading blast radius
entries.promoted_causal_grain: A stale code path was activated through an inconsistent deployment and repurposed flag, causing automated order generation.

entries.title: Northeast Blackout 2003: EMS alarm failure, silent situational-awareness loss, and control-room/IT split
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Silent or poorly communicated EMS/alarm failure within a larger grid-disturbance chain.

entries.title: Equifax 2017: unpatched Struts vulnerability, asset-visibility failure, and inactive exfiltration monitoring
entries.promoted_causal_grain: A known vulnerable web application component remained reachable and unpatched; monitoring meant to catch exfiltration was unavailable.

entries.title: CrowdStrike 2024 Channel File 291 outage: privileged content update, validator gap, and global rollback stress
entries.promoted_causal_grain: A validated content update triggered an out-of-bounds memory read / field-count mismatch in a privileged endpoint-protection path.

entries.title: Volkswagen Dieselgate: defeat-device software, lab-field divergence, and regulator visibility rails
entries.promoted_causal_grain: A software algorithm intentionally changed emissions-control behavior when it detected official testing versus normal driving.

entries.title: Air Canada Flight 143 / Gimli Glider: metric fuel calculation as survivable numeric-representation failure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: fuel exhaustion after insufficient fuel was loaded under an abnormal manual-fuel-calculation workflow

entries.title: Three Mile Island Unit 2: partial meltdown, instrumentation ambiguity, and operating-experience correction
entries.promoted_causal_grain: loss-of-coolant pathway and misdiagnosed plant state during an upset

entries.title: Chornobyl/Chernobyl Unit 4: design features, out-of-procedure operation, and safety/regulatory framework failure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: loss of reactor control during low-power test in an unstable operating state

entries.title: Fukushima Daiichi: tsunami design-basis exceedance, station blackout, and multi-unit severe accident
entries.promoted_causal_grain: extended loss of power and heat removal after tsunami-induced flooding of critical systems

entries.title: West Fertilizer: ammonium-nitrate inventory, responder exposure, and land-use/regulatory gaps
entries.promoted_causal_grain: FGAN fire/explosion sequence; exact ignition-origin details are not the promoted grain in this one-pass record.

entries.title: Imperial Sugar: combustible-dust accumulation, enclosure change, and normalization of deviance
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Combustible sugar dust explosion propagated through dust accumulations and vulnerable enclosed spaces.

entries.title: Chevron Richmond refinery fire: sulfidation corrosion, recommendation-tracking gaps, and hard-data proof burden
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Rupture of carbon-steel piping thinned by sulfidation corrosion, followed by flammable hydrocarbon release and ignition.

entries.title: Macondo / Deepwater Horizon: blowout, safety-critical elements, and offshore process-safety regime gaps
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Loss of well control and blowout followed by ignition; BOP failed to seal during emergency well-control efforts.

entries.title: Hyatt Regency walkways: hanger-rod connection redesign and inadequate load-path capacity
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Insufficient load capacity in box-beam/hanger-rod connections.

entries.title: I-35W bridge: gusset-plate design error, added loads, and inspection/load-rating invisibility
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Inadequate load capacity of U10 gusset plates under combined loads.

entries.title: FIU pedestrian bridge: node 11/12 design error, peer-review failure, cracking response, and road exposure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Load/capacity calculation errors at node 11/12 in the bridge design.

entries.title: Fern Hollow bridge: corrosion, missed maintenance action, fracture-critical identification, and oversight failure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Transverse tie-plate failure due to corrosion and section loss.

entries.title: Champlain Towers South: open NCST investigation, pool-deck/tower hypotheses, records/QC/QA questions
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Open/preliminary; not finalized by this cube.

entries.title: Teton Dam failure: internal erosion, foundation key trench, rapid breach, and dam-safety memory
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Internal erosion/piping at core-foundation interface during first filling, with design/foundation conditions separated from warning/evacuation consequences.

entries.title: Mount Polley tailings storage facility breach: undetected foundation stratum, undrained failure, and post-breach tailings standards
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Undetected foundation layer and undrained response under TSF load, with inspection/regulator scope separated from design conclusion.

entries.title: Feijão Dam I / Brumadinho: upstream tailings dam, flow liquefaction, monitoring non-legibility, and high-consequence exposure
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Flow liquefaction / brittle undrained response in upstream-raised tailings dam, with monitoring non-legibility and high-consequence exposure separated.

entries.title: Fundão tailings dam failure: sands/slimes interaction, unplanned occurrences, and liquefaction flowslide
entries.promoted_causal_grain: Liquefaction flowslide involving sands/slimes interaction and construction/operation history, with full-impact extraction deferred.

entries.refactor: Human-factors accident records must separate actual aircraft/system state, displayed/interpreted state, automation/warning mode, crew coordination, training/procedure, supervision/fatigue, survivability, and legal/safety status.
entries.anti_flattening_rule: Do not use pilot error as a terminal explanation when investigator sources identify system, training, automation, supervision, design, or organizational surfaces.
